en: A sepia-toned historic street view showing a slightly curving, cobblestone-lined street flanked by multi‑story buildings with ornate facades and bay windows. Pedestrians, including children in early‑20th‑century clothing, walk along the sidewalks. The architecture is typical of a German small town. At the top of the image is printed text identifying the location as Borna near Leipzig and the specific street as Reichsstrasse.
